name: LLM-OpsBench
description: No single LLM dominates every workload. LLM-OpsBench benchmarks GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and Llama 3.1 across four tasks, logging cost, latency, and quality per request. Includes Pareto analysis, ablation sweeps, and a Streamlit dashboard for actionable deployment decisions.
